data.title: Customer Success Engineer
data.description:
Who We Are

Our mission is to make the world programmable. Sight is one of the key ways we understand the world, and soon this will be true for the software we use, too.

We’re building the tools, community, and resources needed to make the world programmable with artificial intelligence. Roboflow simplifies building and using computer vision models. Today, over 1M+ developers, including those from half the Fortune 100, use Roboflow’s machine learning open source and hosted tools. That includes counting cells to accelerate cancer research, improving construction site safety, digitizing floor plans, preserving coral reef populations, guiding drone flight, and much more.

Roboflow is supported by great customers and investors, having raised over 63 million from Y Combinator, Google Ventures, Craft Ventures, Sam Altman, Lachy Groom, amongst other leading software investors.

Roboflowers are passionate builders who value ownership, accountability, and a bias toward action. We're curious, hands-on with new tech, and prefer showing our work over talking about it. Many of us have a founder mindset and thrive in our high-autonomy environment.

Who You Are

You are technically curious, customer-focused, and get satisfaction from helping people become capable and confident users of complex technology. You may come from Customer Success, technical enablement, Developer Relations, Support, Solutions Engineering, or another customer-facing technical role.

You enjoy understanding why customers struggle with a product and turning those insights into better ways of teaching thousands of customers — not simply solving the same problem repeatedly.

You are comfortable teaching technical concepts live, creating clear educational content, and guiding customers through unfamiliar workflows. You know when to demonstrate, when to advise, and importantly when to let the customer drive the keyboard.

You look for patterns. If several customers ask the same question, your instinct is not simply to answer it again; it is to create the guide, video, workshop, workflow, or program that means the next customer can answer it themselves.

Empathetic to customer needs and the importance of communicating in remote relationships, you can provide clear and prescriptive guidance while maintaining the boundaries required for a scalable self-service customer experience.

Many Roboflowers have used our tools before joining. One of the best ways to stand out amongst other applicants is to write about something you have built with Roboflow or contribute to one of our open source projects.

We are hiring Customer Success Engineers to help our self-serve and Corporate customers become successful, independent users of Roboflow. You will have direct input on the evolution of this role, the Customer Success Engineering function, and how Roboflow enables an increasingly large community of computer vision practitioners.

If you enjoy teaching technical concepts, building programs and content, and finding scalable ways to help customers succeed, let’s have a chat.

What You’ll Do

Roboflow's product-led growth customers are building an enormous variety of computer vision applications. Customer Success powers up those customers with the technical knowledge, best practices, and structured enablement they need to expand how they use Roboflow and confidently progress from experimentation into production.

The function operates through two complementary enablement models:

  • Scalable enablement — recurring webinars, onboarding sessions, technical workshops, clinics, office hours, learning journeys, and reusable educational content designed to help large numbers of self-serve customers progress independently.

  • Targeted 1:1 enablement — structured, time-bound delivery of the Targeted Enablement Option Pack for qualifying Corporate customers who need additional guidance through core Roboflow functionality.

The objective isn't to do the customer's work for them; it is to remove educational friction and give customers the knowledge, tools, and confidence to progress independently.

You will teach customers how to work effectively with datasets, annotations, model training and evaluation, and the wider Roboflow platform. Just as importantly, you will identify recurring points of friction and turn them into programs and reusable assets that can benefit hundreds or thousands of future customers.

Role And Responsibilities

  • Develop, deliver, and continually improve technical enablement programs for Roboflow's self-serve customer base, covering platform onboarding, annotation strategy and quality, dataset management, model training and evaluation, workflows and deployments and workspace administration

  • Host bi-weekly webinars, technical workshops, office hours, and other live educational sessions

  • Develop learning journeys that guide customers towards increasingly sophisticated use of Roboflow technology

  • Deliver Roboflow's structured 1:1 Targeted Enablement Option Pack for qualifying customers

  • Create reusable technical enablement assets including documentation, videos, walkthroughs, recordings, and reference materials

  • Identify recurring customer questions and turn them into scalable educational programs or assets

  • Monitor customer activation and engagement signals to identify users and cohorts who may benefit from specific enablement programs

  • Measure participation and effectiveness of enablement programs for continual improvement

  • Collaborate with Product to identify and close recurring knowledge and usability gaps

  • Stay current with the latest Roboflow product features, releases, workflows, and recommended best practices

Technical Proficiency

  • Working knowledge of computer vision and machine learning, including datasets, annotation, model training, evaluation, and inference

  • Comfortable using Python and working with APIs, notebooks, and common developer tooling

  • Ability to become highly proficient across the Roboflow platform and demonstrate its workflows confidently to customers

  • Understanding of model evaluation concepts including precision, recall, confidence thresholds, confusion matrices, and common causes of poor model performance

  • Understanding of dataset quality, annotation strategy, dataset versioning, and approaches for identifying difficult or underrepresented examples

  • Ability to translate technical concepts into clear, practical guidance for users with varying levels of ML experience

Individual Skills

  • Technical Teaching: Able to explain unfamiliar technical concepts clearly and adapt the explanation to the customer's level of experience

  • Pattern Recognition: Recognize recurring questions and friction across customer interactions and identify opportunities to solve them systematically

  • Program Delivery: Methodical planning and delivery of structured 1:1 sessions, webinars, workshops, and other customer-facing technical programs

  • Content Creation: Able to create concise, technically accurate educational material across written, recorded, and live formats

  • Workload Management: Manage multiple customers progressing through structured enablement while balancing program delivery and reusable content creation

  • Customer Communication: Communicate clearly and professionally before, during, and after enablement engagements, setting expectations around preparation, outcomes, and next steps

Bonus Skills

  • Experience using the Roboflow platform or contributing to the Roboflow ecosystem

  • Previous experience in Customer Success, technical enablement, Developer Relations, technical education, Solutions Engineering, or technical Support

  • Experience creating technical educational content such as tutorials, videos, workshops, documentation, or developer courses

  • Experience delivering webinars, workshops, technical demonstrations, or customer training

  • Experience working with product-led growth or self-service SaaS customers

  • Experience using product telemetry or customer activation data to inform customer engagement programs

Who You'll Be Working With

Our team of over 100 attracts talent like executives that wanted to return to building, founders with a 100M+ exit, Roboflow users turned team members, open source contributors, a cyclist who biked across the United States, prolific high school hackers, a CTO from 100+ engineering organization, amongst many exceptional others.

As an early Customer Success Engineer hire, you'll work closely with Support & Success leadership and partner with Product, Sales, and Field Engineering. You won't simply inherit an established playbook — you'll help build the programs, content, tooling, and working practices that define Customer Success at Roboflow.

Where You'll Work

Roboflow is distributed across the US and Europe. We currently have Hubs in New York City, San Francisco and São Paulo (with plans to open more as we grow density in new cities). We provide opportunities (like team onsites in different cities) and resources (like a $4000/yr travel stipend) to work in person with other team members as much as you'd like, while also supporting remote team members. You can work from one of our Hubs (we offer a relocation bonus), work from home, work at co-working spaces, etc. We want you to work where you work best!

When You'll Work

Roboflow primarily operates during the daytime hours in the US and there are some synchronous meetings you’ll be expected to attend each week.

What You'll Receive

To determine your salary, we use a number of market and data-driven salary sources. We review all salaries every six months to ensure we stay in line with the market.

📈 In addition to our cash compensation, we offer generous perks and benefits. Below are some of the highlights:

  • $4000/yr Travel Stipend to travel anywhere anytime to work alongside other Roboflowers

  • $350/mo Productivity stipend to spend on things that make your work environment more productive, like high-speed internet at home or a co-working space

  • Cover up to 100% of your health insurance costs for you and your partner or family

  • Equity in the company so we are all invested in the future of computer vision

📅 Within one week, you will…

  • Learn about computer vision, our product, company, customers, and vision

  • Complete the core self-serve Roboflow journey from dataset creation through model training and inference

  • Begin shadowing customer enablement and Support interactions to understand common customer friction

📅 Within one month, you will…

  • Onboard in person with your manager (you'll come to our NY or SF Hub!)

  • Become familiar with the Customer Success Engineer function, Targeted Enablement Option Pack, and its scope boundaries

  • Shadow and begin participating in Targeted Enablement sessions

  • Compose your first Targeted Enablement Program

  • Create or significantly improve your first reusable customer enablement artifact

  • Participate in 1:many enablement webinars

📅 Within six months, you will…

  • Independently own and deliver both recurring 1:many enablement programs and 1:1 Targeted Enablement engagements.

  • Own and improve reusable educational content and enablement programs

  • Identify recurring customer friction and turn those insights into improvements across Product, Support, and CSE

  • Demonstrate measurable contribution to customer adoption and scalable reduction of repetitive enablement demand

Not sure if this is you?

We want a diverse, global team with a broad range of experience and perspectives. If this job sounds great, but you’re not sure if you qualify, look into our Former Founders role. We carefully consider every application and will either move forward with you, find another team that might be a better fit, keep in touch for future opportunities, or thank you for your time.

Learn More About Us

We are building a diverse Distributed team that is distributed across the globe. Roboflow is an equal opportunity workplace; we welcome people from all backgrounds, communities, and experiences.

We provide competitive compensation and stellar benefits to accelerate your personal and work life. Learn more about what it is like to work at Roboflow by reading these blog posts.

See our careers page for all open listings.
data.summary: The Customer Success Engineer helps self-serve and Corporate customers become capable, independent users of Roboflow’s computer vision platform. Responsibilities include delivering live and one-to-one technical enablement, creating reusable educational content and programs, identifying recurring customer friction, and partnering with Product and other teams to improve customer adoption and self-service.

data.title: Senior Manager, Customer Expansion
data.description:
Dandy is transforming the massive and antiquated dental industry—an industry worth over $400B. Backed by some of the world’s leading venture capital firms, we’re on an ambitious mission to simplify and modernize every function of the dental practice through technology. As we expand our reach globally, Dandy is building the operating system for dental offices around the world—empowering clinicians and their teams with technology, innovation, and world-class support to achieve more for their practices, their people, and their patients.

About the Role

As we scale our post-sale organization, we’re seeking a Senior Manager, Customer Expansion to build and lead our expansion motion across Dandy’s existing customer base.

The team combines proactive BDR-led outbound with high-touch events, training, and field motions that help customers adopt additional products and unlock more value from Dandy.

This role is equal parts strategic builder and people leader. You’ll build the operating model and playbooks, lead through frontline managers across BDR and STS teams, and partner closely with Account Management, Training, Sales, Marketing, and RevOps to make expansion a repeatable, scalable revenue motion.

We’re looking for a strong operator who knows how to build teams, create clarity, coach leaders, and get things done. This isn’t about running an existing sales machine—we’re looking for someone who can build one.

What You'll Do

  • Build and lead the Expansion organization, developing a high-performing team through frontline leaders across BDR and STS (Sales & Training Specialist) functions

  • Develop and refine repeatable expansion playbooks across Dandy’s product portfolio, from customer identification and outbound through product education and activation

  • Build the BDR-to-STS motion and the playbook for events, in-person trainings, and other high-touch expansion opportunities

  • Establish the team's operating cadence, metrics, and accountability systems, using leading indicators to identify gaps and drive action

  • Partner with Account Management, Sales, Training, Marketing, Product, and RevOps to identify opportunities and remove friction from the expansion journey

  • Build feedback loops to understand what is working, where customers are getting stuck, and which motions should scale

  • Test, iterate, and operationalize new expansion motions as the business evolves

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of B2B sales, customer growth, or related commercial experience, with 3+ years managing and developing sales teams and frontline leaders

  • Proven track record of building and scaling teams, ideally in a high-growth or evolving environment

  • Strong operational discipline—you naturally bring structure to ambiguous problems, establish clear metrics, and follow through on execution

  • Strong commercial instincts and an understanding of how to translate customer engagement into revenue, adoption, and retention

  • Strong ability to build processes, playbooks, and operating rhythms from scratch

  • High agency and a bias toward action

  • Excellent cross-functional communication and ability to operate effectively across strategy and execution

Bonus Points For

  • Experience building an expansion, cross-sell, account growth, or customer revenue motion

  • Experience managing BDR and/or STS teams through frontline leaders

  • Experience with events, field sales, customer training, or other high-touch commercial motions

  • Experience operating across both SMB and Enterprise

  • Familiarity with dental, healthcare, SaaS, or other recurring-revenue businesses

For full-time positions, Dandy offers a wide range of best-in-class, comprehensive, and inclusive benefits tailored to each country where we operate. Our local benefits packages typically include healthcare, dental, mental health support, parental planning resources, retirement savings options, and generous paid time off—ensuring our team members are supported no matter where they live and work.

Dandy is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture that celebrates authenticity to win as one. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, citizenship or immigration status, or any other legally protected characteristics.

Dandy also fully complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). We are dedicated to embracing challenges and creating an accessible, inclusive workplace for all individuals. If you require any accommodations for your interview or have any questions beforehand, rest assured that we will do everything we can to meet your needs. Visit Dandy Careers for more!

Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you consent to Dandy collecting, storing, and processing your personal information for recruitment purposes in accordance with our Privacy Policy and GDPR regulations. You have the right to access, rectify, or request the deletion of your data at any time by contacting Privacy Requests.

data.title: Clinical Applications Specialist - Dosimetrist (travelling Position)
data.description:
Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.

Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.

Provides clinical training and support to customers, as a subject matter expert in dosimetry, on-site and/or remotely to ensure customer is prepared to operate their equipment according to a minimum of safe and effective use guidelines and to fully utilize the complex functionality of the technology to meet their business needs.

Summary:


  • Provides clinical applications training to customers both on site and remotely to ensure customer is well prepared to obtain training that will enable them to operate their Varian Medical System equipment according to a minimum of safe and effective use guidelines with the highest level of satisfaction.
  • Assist in managing the customer’s clinical expectations.
  • As available, provides competitive product performance information to headquarters, marketing or engineering groups.
  • May coordinate or lead customer and/or employee training courses.
  • May conduct large group presentations at seminars, training programs, and trade shows.
  • May provide demo support to local, regional and national customer trade events.
  • Formulate complementary support training information in the form of quick tips, workbooks, video-media and implementation guides.
  • Work with cross-functional teams as necessary to support and enable best services and optimize customer relations.
  • Applicable to the Oncology Systems business only: Position must have full access to VMS client sites to perform the essential functions of this position. Many VMS clients require VMS employees and representatives to meet certain “Vendor Credentialing” requirements before they will be allowed to have access to their sites. Unless prohibited by law, position must meet all Vendor Credentialing requirements necessary to have full client access, and must continue to meet those requirements during the course of VMS employment in this position.

  • Other duties as assigned by Training Operations and/or Applications Manager.

Minimum Required Skills and Knowledge:


  • Must be a Certified Dosimetrist.
  • Clinical understanding of the processes in a medical and/or radiation oncology department.
  • Travel required up to 75-100% and intermittent weekends.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills.
  • Exemplary communication skills (listening, verbal, written).
  • Adaptable, positive and open to new ideas and/or situations
  • Highly motivated self-starter who takes initiative.
  • Enthusiastic learner who is eager to meet challenges and quickly assimilate new concepts.
  • Required Certifications and Training: Obtains and completes LMS training plan specific to assigned responsibility
  • Applicable to the Oncology Systems business only: Meets all Vendor Credentialing requirements necessary to gain VMS client site access, unless prohibited by law. These requirements vary by client and may include, but are not limited to:
    • Proof of valid identification (photo, driver’s license, SSN)
    • Criminal background check
    • Drug screen
    • Immunizations (Hep B, MMR, Varicella, Influenza, Tetanus)
    • Annual TB testing
    • Healthcare trainings
    • Experience Level with Business Tools: Experienced knowledge in use of remote training tools (i.e. Smart Connect, virtual classroom) and business tools such as: Microsoft Office Suite, SalesForce, ServiceMax, Qlikview and Learning Management System (LMS).
  • Scope Complete understanding and wide application of documentation, standards, principles, concepts and techniques in the field.
  • Has substantial understanding of the job and applies knowledge and skills to complete a wide range of tasks
  • Job Complexity: Works on assignments that are moderately difficult, requiring judgment in resolving issues or in making recommendations.
  • Proficient at leading a team and taking on special assignments.
  • Proficient delivery of training for a minimum of 20%-30% of Varian products.
  • Experienced product knowledge to support cross functional teams (i.e. trade shows, sales support, marketing, testing).
  • Mentors Clinical Training Specialist I and II.
  • Impact of Decisions and Accuracy: Erroneous decisions or failure to achieve results may negatively impact or delay internal and external customer satisfaction and financial obligations.
  • Interaction: Interacts daily with functional peer groups and external customers
  • Builds effective working relationships with both internal and external customers.
  • Supervision Receives little instruction on day to- day work, general instructions on newly introduced assignments.
  • Administrative Compliance in good standing.
  • Competency Level Solid proficiencies, some strengths and opportunities for development of identified areas in development plan.
  • Typical Education and Experience: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent Minimum of 2 -3 years clinical experience or equivalent 3 years in position Enrollment in Varian approved Development Program.

data.title: Support Analyst
data.description:
SUPPORT ANALYST

Fully Remote  |  Full-Time  |  Customer Support  |  Reports to Manager, Support Services |

About the Role

Harris Computer is looking for a driven, tech-savvy Support Analyst to join our growing team. In this role, you'll be the front line of support for our customers — diagnosing technical issues, providing solutions, and ensuring a seamless experience with our software products. You'll report to the Manager, Support Services, and work in a fully remote, fast-paced environment where problem-solving, clear communication, and modern tools, including AI, are part of daily work. If you thrive on solving problems and are passionate about customer success, we want to hear from you.

Why Join Us

  • Work fully remote, with a supportive team and manager invested in your growth
  • Build deep expertise in mission-critical software used by customers who depend on it every day
  • Grow your technical and customer-facing skills, with a clear path to take on more complex, high-impact issues

Core Responsibilities

  • Own assigned customer tickets from intake through resolution, including timely responses, clear status updates, and accurate documentation
  • Diagnose and resolve functional, configuration, data, and software issues by asking effective questions, reproducing problems, and identifying root causes
  • Escalate complex issues to Development, QA, or Product with complete findings, reproduction steps, and actions already attempted
  • Communicate technical information clearly and manage customer expectations throughout the resolution process
  • Learn, implement, and deliver training on our software applications to both customers and internal stakeholders
  • Create and maintain knowledge-base content, including solutions, procedures, and best practices that improve customer self-service
  • Identify recurring issues and product or process gaps, and share trends with the appropriate teams
  • Identify and communicate additional revenue or upsell opportunities to the appropriate internal teams
  • Collaborate with Support colleagues and cross-functional partners, sharing knowledge and contributing to testing when needed

AI Tools & Proficiency

As part of our commitment to innovation, we expect Support Analysts to use AI tools as a core part of their daily workflow, always validating outputs and following company data and privacy requirements.

Required:

  • Demonstrated experience using AI-powered productivity tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Claude) to draft communications, summarize issues, or research solutions
  • Ability to use AI tools to triage, document, and resolve customer support tickets more efficiently
  • Comfort working alongside AI-assisted support platforms, including chatbots and automated ticketing suggestions

Preferred:

  • Basic understanding of prompt engineering — crafting clear, effective prompts to get high-quality outputs from AI tools
  • Experience contributing to or maintaining an AI-assisted knowledge base
  • Familiarity with AI integrations within CRM or helpdesk platforms (e.g., Salesforce Einstein, Zendesk AI)

What we are looking for:

  • 2+ years of experience in technical support, software support, or customer service
  • BS/BA degree in a related business or technical field, or equivalent industry experience
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, with the discipline to investigate beyond the immediate symptom
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical users
  • Customer-focused, professional, and patient approach, with the ability to build trust and remain composed under pressure
  • Strong organization and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities independently in a remote environment
  • Team player who is willing to share knowledge, seek help, and support team goals

What would make you stand out:

  • Experience with local government, municipal finance, taxation, or related public-sector workflows
  • Experience with ticketing and work-management platforms such as TeamSupport or Jira
  • Working knowledge of SQL, databases, APIs, or reporting tools
  • Experience creating knowledge-base articles, technical documentation, or customer training content

Salary range: $50,000 - $55,000 USD per year.


AAP/EEO Statement

Harris Computer is an EEO/AA/Disability/Vets Employer.


Other Duties:

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

data.title: Ep Mapping Specialist Cas - Hartford, Ct
data.description:
We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on - 17 Oct 2026


 

Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

A Day in the Life

Job Description

Join Medtronic as an Affera Mapping Specialist and be at the forefront of transforming lives through advanced medical technology! In this dynamic role, you’ll work alongside a collaborative team of clinicians, engineers, physicians, and innovators to execute mapping solutions for cardiac and other electrophysiological systems. By blending technical expertise with a passion for improving patient outcomes, you'll have the opportunity to impact global healthcare directly. If you're driven by precision, problem-solving, and the chance to make a tangible difference in people’s lives, this is your opportunity to grow your career while shaping the future of medical innovation at Medtronic.

We are seeking a committed professional to join our team. While this is a remote position not located at a physical Medtronic site, the candidate hired will be required to reside within the territory and drive to multiple accounts throughout the region. A valid driver's license is essential for this role.


To find all CAS Mapping roles available please use #casmap in the key word search at Medtronic Careers 

Various levels available based on qualifications and experience 

Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned.

  • Provide clinical and technical support and training to physicians and staff on the EP mapping and navigation system and all CAS products.

  • Educate and train physicians, hospital personnel and office staff on technical matters relating to CAS products and related procedures.

  • Promote the safe and effective use of Medtronic CAS products and related procedures.

  • Understand and support national, regional and territory sales objectives to achieve or exceed sales goals within all CAS products. 

  • Develop and cultivate customer relationships resulting in incremental business.

  • Work in partnership with Account Manager, Regional Manager and Area Directors to identify potential sales opportunities.

  • Collaborate and strategize with local sales team to conduct customer training for mapping and other CA Solutions products.

  • Collaborate and communicate with the sales and clinical teams in the region.

  • Serves as an effective Medtronic CAS representative to physicians and support staff regarding Medtronic CAS products, service and support.

  • Serve as a regional champion to share your experience and influence others to be proficient in the mapping technology.
